title: The Winter Regiment
author: Wren Okafor
blurb: Ada Winterbourne, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
